scenarios.name: CloudflareAgentsX402
scenarios.checks: 4 PASS / 7 FAIL (11 scenarios): CANON baseline PASS (1 paid call = 1 verify, 1 settle, 1 exec, payment-response.success=true); controls W-CAP1 (over-cap rejected pre-signer: 'Payment exceeds client cap: 200000 > 100000'), NEG1 (upto-scheme passthrough, signature NOT created), NEG2 (confirmation-callback mutation blocked by structuredClone — signed values stay original) PASS. Confirmed windows: W1 amount/quote-binding FAIL (High, bounded by the $0.10 default cap — 402 returns amount=50000 ($0.05) vs advertised 10000; client signed eip3009_value=50000 without checking against the price; the cap is the only guard); W2 settle-after-delivery FAIL (High — SETTLEMENT_FAILED wrapped as a fresh 402 with accepts; client wrapper retries once, then caller retry: exec=2, verify=2, settle=2 for one logical operation); W3 retry idempotency FAIL (High — two consecutive callTool = two full rounds; no durable pending-state, no idempotency key, no nonce dedup); W4 cross-tool replay FAIL (Medium-High — findMatchingRequirements matches scheme/network/price only, token not bound to the tool name); W5 payTo-binding FAIL (Critical, funds rerouting — 402 with payTo=0xbaadf00d…0000; client signed eip3009_to=0xbAadF00D…0000, a valid EIP-3009 witness, with no payTo-vs-expected-recipient check; same surface as BlockRun F1 / argus-seal-0006); W-MCP FAIL (High — confirmationCallback absent by default: two callTool = two signatures, two settles, two executes, zero user dialogs; silent double-charge on retry/double-click/pendingPayments eviction); W-CAP2 FAIL (Medium, dust — amount=1 ($0.000001) signed silently; onBeforePaymentCreation only rejects value<0n and value>cap, no minimum). Fixation 2026-10-30T13:01:00Z.

findings_summary.title: Critical — payTo-binding missing (SUT-1 CF, SUT-2 Circle): the client signs the payment authorization over an attacker-controlled payTo from the 402 response without any check against the expected recipient — funds rerouting on-chain; same surface as BlockRun F1 (argus-seal-0006). CDP ships the fix shape (allowedPayees) but only as an opt-in guardrail.

Silent double-charge on paid tool calls (SUT-1 CF, SUT-2 Circle; inherited via the shared x402Client in SUT-3): no confirmation callback by default, no idempotency key, no nonce dedup — retry / double-click / eviction recovery re-signs and re-settles for one logical operation.

Amount/quote binding missing; default-cap posture uneven (W1 + W-CAP1): server-declared 402 amounts are signed without binding to the advertised price — CF bounded by its $0.10 default cap, Circle unbounded (no default cap, opt-in only), CdpX402Client removes the upstream $1 default cap (F-WNOCONTROLS); with W-CAP2 both directions of amount mismatch are unguarded by default.

Settle-after-delivery double execution (SUT-1 CF, SUT-2 Circle): SETTLEMENT_FAILED surfaces as a fresh 402-with-accepts (CF) or a throw -> caller retry (both) — a lost settle response yields a second full round (verify/settle/exec x2) with no recovery handles and no idempotency.

Retry idempotency absent (SUT-1 CF, SUT-2 Circle): every retry mints a fresh nonce with no client-side tracking or dedup; SUT-2 signatures stay valid for the full 7-day validity window — dedup is left entirely to the gateway.

Signed token not bound to its target (SUT-1 CF: cross-tool same-price replay — token matched by scheme/network/price only; SUT-2 Circle: no resource-URL binding, 7-day window): a signature issued for one tool/resource is accepted for another.
No minimum-amount check (all three SUTs): dust amounts (1 atomic = $0.000001 vs $0.01 advertised) are signed silently — combined with W1/W-CAP1 the whole amount range is unguarded by default.
